title: Canonical Command Work Freshness and Staleness integration
goal: Implement CAP-CMD-109 progressively under Command owner; source health and policy remain with upstream source/Shared owners; never guess defaults or claim full staleness capability from a read-only slice.
invariants: Command interprets only source-owned time/health and explicitly versioned policy inputs; Shared owns external health, background jobs and global freshness standards.
First Class-0 child only; no claim of incident/Task lifecycle, follow-up Task creation, acknowledgement, refresh job or production IAM.
security_properties: No source metadata without current tenant/environment and object Owner.CanRead.
Untrusted clock, missing policy or unavailable source never silently implies current.

migration.rationale: Planning container only; first child is read-only.

rollback.strategy: Revert unaccepted child implementation while preserving existing Command Work Queue.

inputs: CAP-CMD-109 canonical complete, Command module, CAP-CMD-101 consume-only boundary, source/health ownership.
outputs: E10-CMD-109A-FRESHNESS small read-only optional owner-sourced freshness projection, further Shared/host/source integration later.
acceptance_tests: Child has independently verified behavior and security checks.
Epic stays DECOMPOSED until full CAP-CMD-109 and production owner integrations accepted.
definition_of_ready: CAP-CMD-109 has a canonical Command owner and E10-SCALE-005B is graph VERIFIED.
definition_of_done: All CAP-CMD-109 source/time/health/tenant policy, safe refresh/follow-up and cross-product integration obligations validated by canonical authority, not inferred from first Class-0 projection.
